art_direction.summary: Geometric Swiss-precision illustrations for dossier/regulatory motifs: document stacks, cross-check arrows, fiche-rule grids, audit timeline nodes. Signal green sparingly; stone linework on off-white.
references_craft: Notion line icons at larger scale

style_codification.fill_style: flat fills with one accent; minimal hatching
style_codification.perspective: isometric 15° or flat orthographic; no exaggerated 3D

illustrations.subject: Cross-document validation
illustrations.concept: Multiple document planes linked by green consistency threads
illustrations.generation_prompt: Geometric vector-style illustration: three floating dossier planes connected by thin signal-green consistency lines on off-white field, stone outlines, Swiss precision, isometric subtle. No text, letters, words, or logos in the illustration.

illustrations.subject: Fiche / programme rules
illustrations.concept: Grid of standardised operation cards referencing CEE fiche shape without inventing IDs
illustrations.generation_prompt: Flat geometric illustration of a neat grid of blank programme rule cards with one highlighted card and green corner mark, stone lines, off-white background. Abstract — no readable fiche codes. No text, letters, words, or logos in the illustration.

illustrations.subject: Audit trail timeline
illustrations.concept: Horizontal timestamp nodes with check accents
illustrations.generation_prompt: Minimal geometric timeline of five nodes with thin stone connectors and two green check dots, wide banner. No text, letters, words, or logos in the illustration.

illustrations.subject: Exception queue
illustrations.concept: Inbox stack with amber caution tab + green resolved tab
illustrations.generation_prompt: Square spot illustration: stacked abstract tickets, one amber tab, one green resolved mark, geometric flat style. No text, letters, words, or logos in the illustration.

illustrations.subject: Obligé / délégataire handoff
illustrations.concept: Two labelled-role silhouettes as abstract blocks exchanging a dossier — roles shown via shape not text
illustrations.generation_prompt: Two geometric building-block figures exchanging a dossier folder icon, clear spatial roles, stone and green accents, educational RegTech diagram style. No text, letters, words, or logos in the illustration.

illustrations.subject: Validation check motif
illustrations.concept: Abstract check inside rounded-square status chip
illustrations.generation_prompt: Simple geometric status chip with abstract check shape in #2EE600 on #FAFAF9, stone border. No text, letters, words, or logos in the illustration.

illustrations.subject: EU programme map abstract
illustrations.concept: Connected nodes for CEE, Conto Termico, BEG, ECO4, MOVES III as abstract marks — not a political map claim
illustrations.generation_prompt: Abstract network of five geometric nodes with thin connectors on off-white, one node emphasized in green for FR CEE focus, no map borders, no country names. No text, letters, words, or logos in the illustration.
